prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, demi-statue demi statue portrait, horizontally split crystal-over-vessel body, every seam physically stepped, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually finished thigh tips a little further below the middle of her thighs, just above where the knee would be, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her form comes to an end, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman in ko-gyaru makeup — deeply sun-tanned bronze makeup over real skin, bold white eyeshadow across the lids, white glossy lips, a bright turquoise liner accent at the outer corners, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, long bleached blonde hair with sun-streaked highlights, a bright cheeky grin. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a huge thick gold hoop hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder.

Physique: A colossal heavy chest wider than her shoulders, a waistline that still pulls in sharply, then an enormous belly and colossal wide hips flaring out again, her upper body crystal, lower body a rose-petal vessel, demi-statue

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of the neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step, casting a crisp shadow. Below this line, there is no bare skin anywhere on her body below this line — every part, without exception, is one of the materials described.

A single straight horizontal line runs across her body at the waist. Above it (shoulders, arms, chest): solid transparent golden-yellow citrine crystal crystal. Below it (belly, hips, both legs): a glass vessel of clear rose-pink water with drifting rose petals. At every seam where two pieces meet, one edge rises very slightly above its neighbour, casting a thin, crisp shadow — proving each piece is a truly separate object, not a flat pattern painted on one surface. A little further below the middle of her thighs, just above where the knee would be, her left thigh seals shut into its own small, smooth, rounded, closed tip (the bottom band); her right thigh seals shut into its own small, smooth, rounded, closed tip (the bottom band).

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a warm golden amber on one side and a deep charcoal grey on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so amber light glances off one side and grey light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
